## 🎯 Learning objectives

After completing this tutorial, you will be able to:

-   Load and inspect vector datasets in QGIS\
-   Create a custom 2×2 km analysis grid\
-   Aggregate land-use categories per grid cell\
-   Export results for further analysis or mapping

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 🧰 Prerequisites

::: callout-note
### Software & skills

-   **QGIS 3.40 LTR** installed\
-   Basic familiarity with the QGIS interface (layers panel, attribute table)
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 📁 Data & setup

Download the following datasets:

-   **CORINE Land Cover (CLC 2018)** – vector\
-   **Administrative boundary** of your study area

Place all files in a single project folder:

\`\`\`text project/ ├── data/ │ ├── clc_2018.gpkg │ └── boundary.gpkg └── qgis/ └── analysis.qgz
